notes.title: v1.0.6
notes.content:
Bugfixes:

    - Minor shadow rendering issues have been fixed.

    - The battle camera should no longer pan to the wrong side.

Gameplay:

    - Gado’s damage potential has been slightly increased.

    - Maiev’s defensive stats have been slightly improved.

    - The highest armor tier now requires more materials.

    - More chests containing materials have been distributed throughout the game world.

    - Some environments have received a visual upgrade:

    *Doridenna
    *Flyn
    *Kardstein
    *Tortuga
    *Meng Gao
    *Hombern
    *Archive Haven
    *The Final Dungeon
    *The Secret Dungeon

notes.title: v1.0.4
notes.content:
New inclusions:

- Improved dialogue in Jaskya's introduction chapter.
- New cutscene after completing Chapter 3.
- New cutscene upon first visit to Tortuga.
- New cutscene when entering the final dungeon for the first time.


Gameplay

- Reduced cooldown on Fire Titan abilities.
- Slightly reduced health of Gado Stone.
- Slightly reduced Gado Stone's mobility.
- Slightly increased health of Leon Braithheart. 
- Slightly increases the mobility of Leon Braithheart.


Bug fixes

- Corrected some translation errors.
- Some mapping errors have been fixed.

notes.title: v1.0.3
notes.content:
Bugfixes:

- some treasure chests had the wrong asset, this was fixed.
- Fixed a bug where opening the extra menu could freeze the game.
- Fixed a bug where Lambert's Final Slash ability did not show up in the skill learn menu.


Gameplay:

- Losing in Trouble Quad will no longer cost the player Jac (gold).

- Winning in Trouble Quad will now give random materials as reward (instead of Jac (gold)).
Better Trouble Quad enemies will give advanced materials.

- Trouble Quad players in the game world are now easier to spot as they have a unique look now.

- Reduced the difficulty of the Trouble Quad tournament in chapter 6.
